Press Release


Published: September 17, 2026


# Trane® Introduces New AI and Digital Solutions for Intelligent Building Performance


Media Contact


Dan Smith


Commercial HVAC, Americas


dsmith@tranetechnologies.com


#### *Latest digital innovations help customers adapt to increasing operational complexity through a more proactive, integrated approach to building operations, improving performance and reducing waste*


####


**DAVIDSON, N.C., September 17, 2026** – Trane® – by Trane Technologies (NYSE: TT), a global climate innovator, is introducing new AI and digital solutions spanning Trane Cloud applications, connected controls and intelligent thermal management. From analytics that can help turn building data into clearer operational priorities to connected tools that simplify maintenance workflows and coordinated controls for high-performance cooling, these innovations help customers bring greater visibility, responsiveness and consistency to how buildings and mission-critical environments are monitored, managed and maintained.


As digital infrastructure and automation become more central to building performance, Trane is expanding applications and controls that help address more complex operations shaped by growing volumes of building data, rising uptime expectations, and service workflows that often remain fragmented across disconnected tools and teams. These solutions connect insight, workflows, and system management across a wider range of building environments to support earlier action across day-to-day operations.


“As building operations become more connected and more complex, we’re evolving our AI and digital portfolio to help customers operate with greater clarity and control,” said Chris Tanaka, Vice President of Product Management, Trane Technologies. “With Trane Cloud Analytics and Maintenance Manager, customers can connect building data, service workflows, and asset history to support earlier action, better coordination, and more informed planning. Across the broader portfolio, these new solutions extend that same approach into controls and system management to help customers improve performance and reduce waste over time.”


That same focus on connected intelligence and coordinated system management also extends to mission-critical environments, including data centers, where cooling performance is increasingly shaping uptime, efficiency and long-term infrastructure strategy.


"As data center growth drives higher cooling loads, tighter performance requirements, and faster response expectations, thermal management is becoming increasingly integral to uptime, efficiency, and long-term infrastructure strategy," said Oakley Roberts, President of Data Centers, Trane Technologies. "Intelligent, coordinated cooling systems are becoming essential to operating modern AI and mission-critical infrastructure at scale. These innovations help customers improve available capacity, strengthen resilience, and maintain consistent thermal performance as computing demands continue to accelerate."


Together, these innovations reflect a broader shift toward digital tools that bring greater clarity, tighter control, and more coordinated system intelligence across the built environment.


For building owners, operators, and facilities teams, the new portfolio includes:


- **Trane Cloud Analytics** unlocks connected equipment and system data to provide prioritized insights tied to energy, comfort and reliability. Analytics help teams surface performance trends, highlight inefficiencies affecting energy use and occupant conditions, and support faster, more informed operational decisions across connected buildings.
- **Trane® Maintenance Manager** replaces spreadsheets, paper records and disconnected tools with one connected maintenance experience in Trane Cloud. Work orders, asset records, maintenance history and documentation are centralized to help streamline workflows, improve service coordination, and support better-informed repair, replacement and capital planning decisions.
- **Cloud Connected BACnet Thermostat** connects light commercial buildings to cloud-based building management without requiring a full existing Building Management System (BMS). Fast cloud connectivity, remote monitoring, support for rooftop and heat pump applications, and compatibility with existing HVAC equipment help make it easier to manage building performance without replacing installed systems.
- **Tracer® Zone Sensors** deliver flexible wired and wireless 4-in-1 sensing technology with simplified setup, faster sensing performance and broader application flexibility. The expanded sensor portfolio is a seamless choice for new construction, upgrades, retrofits, and remodeling projects without sacrificing responsiveness, functionality or aesthetics.
- **AI Control for Water Systems** brings AI, system-level thinking and trusted expertise to turn chiller plant management into a performance multiplier. The functionality continuously learns and helps adjust chiller plant setpoints to help improve plant efficiency, strengthen coordinated capacity management and enhance performance across existing chilled water systems.


For data center operators, featured solutions include:


- **Chiller Plant Manager** continuously interprets live operating data with built-in redundancy and rapid decision logic to coordinate cooling plant performance in mission-critical environments. These capabilities help protect uptime and critical assets, guide capacity allocation and simplify plant management to deliver intelligent performance in mission-critical environments.
- **Data Hall Team Control** embeds system-level intelligence directly at the unit level to transform multiple cooling units into one, resilient system. This approach simplifies deployment with built-in redundancy and automated failover, designed to help protect uptime, simplify operation and maintain consistent thermal performance across complex data center environments.
